assertions.description: The static router the demos install with. Checked from a plain worker so no registration is needed.
assertions.test: (async()=>{try{const src='self.postMessage(typeof self.InstallEvent==="function"&&Object.getOwnPropertyNames(self.InstallEvent.prototype).includes("addRoutes"));';const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([src],{type:'text/javascript'}));const w=new Worker(url);const ok=await new Promise((r)=>{w.onmessage=(e)=>r(e.data===true);setTimeout(()=>r(false),3000);});w.terminate();URL.revokeObjectURL(url);return ok;}catch(e){return false;}})()

assertions.description: Route conditions are URL patterns. This demo deliberately uses full pathnames rather than wildcards, because an ambiguous pattern would route the wrong requests and make every measurement on the sibling pages meaningless.

Routes apply only to requests from a controlled client, so a page must be able to tell whether it is controlled. An unclaimed page bypasses the router entirely, which is the commonest reason a routing demo appears to do nothing.
